Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear list. For AWS marketplace + co-sell, the minimal set we need to move an ISV to co-sell-ready is: 

1) SOC 2: either the full Type II report (preferred) or a SOC2 attestation letter plus the summary. If you only have the summary, include the auditor name and the period covered.
2) Penetration test: an executive summary/attestation from the vendor is acceptable for initial enablement; full pen test report is required for listing in certain regulated categories.
3) Signed DPA: we need a signed copy (DocuSign link ok) with residency & subprocessors section filled.
4) Evidence of vulnerability management and patch cadence (one-pager ok).

Redaction guidance: redact customer-specific findings and full IP addresses. Auditor contact info is fine to include for validation, we rarely need the auditor’s raw attachments.

Portal links & next steps: please upload artifacts to the AWS partner portal here: https://partners.amazon.com/marketplace/portal/records/12345 — once uploaded, request a review and I’ll route to the co-sell ops reviewer. Typical review turnaround: 5–7 business days. If you want priority review for a co-sell enablement push, mark it as "Co-Sell Priority" and cc me on the submission.

DocuSign: send signed DPA to marketplace-legal@amazon.com (or share a DocuSign link).

Suggested timeline: upload by Tue 2/10 for an expedited 2/3 week path to listing + co-sell enablement.

Hope that helps — I’ll follow up with the exact co-sell ops reviewer once you’ve uploaded.

Best,
Lisa Martin
Partner Programs — ISV Marketplace
Amazon Web Services
